      Transparency Statement

      Hello, I'm a Virtual Assistant. I can help you with questions about Dell products and services.

      I use AI to process your questions and generate answers, and our interaction is monitored and recorded. If you do not want to be monitored or recorded, please do not interact with me. I am still learning and sometimes my answers may lack context or may not contain all data that you might be seeking, so please also review the information available on Dell.com.

      I can only answer questions about Dell products and services. Any information you share with me will be stored for up to 30 days. This information may be used to train me and improve my responses, and could potentially be shared with other parties for processing, support, or other uses related to me but will not be available to other parties for their own use. You can review the Dell Privacy Statement.

      AI-generated responses may not always be accurate. Service and product availability varies by region. For more details, contact Sales Support.

      If you're using a public or shared device, be sure to close the browser session when you're finished.

      If you are an adult over the age of 18 and want to proceed, please select the "Continue" button.

      End Chat

      Thanks for helping us improve the Virtual Assistant experience.

      The chat will not be saved and can't be resumed later.
